title: Charges and consumables
summary: Items can now track charges or uses, such as a wand with 7 charges or a stack of potions. Use spends one, and the DM can recharge.
items: The DM turns on Track uses in an item's Edit and chooses what happens to the last use: remove the item (one of a stack, the next starts full) or keep it at 0 until recharged.
Players can use their own character's items from the ⋯ menu; the DM can use any item and recharge it to any number up to the maximum.
Each use and recharge appears once in activity and never moves money; pressing again after an error never spends twice.
